title: Compute structure-dependent energy components
action: Compute the Madelung coefficient, the second-order energy E2, and the three third-order contributions E3^I, E3^II, E3^III for the simple cubic (sc), face-centered cubic (fcc), and body-centered cubic (bcc) lattices. This involves summing over reciprocal lattice vectors, evaluating the Lindhard screening function χ(q), and numerically evaluating the integrals I(g1,g2) and I(g) as defined in the paper. Use appropriate methods to handle the singular behavior near g=2.
description: A JSON object with keys 'sc', 'fcc', 'bcc'. Each value is an object containing the dimensionless energy coefficients.
output_schema: Object with top-level keys 'sc', 'fcc', 'bcc'. Each value is an object with numeric fields: E_M_alpha_rs, E2, E3_I_over_alpha_rs, E3_II_over_alpha_rs, E3_III_over_alpha_rs.

title: Compute elastic constant expansion coefficients
action: Using the previously computed Madelung, second-order, and third-order energy terms, derive the strain-derivative expressions to obtain the elastic constant expansion coefficients A_i and B_i for each cubic structure. Sum over reciprocal lattice vectors according to the perturbation-theory formulas.
description: A JSON object with keys 'sc', 'fcc', 'bcc'. Each value contains the dimensionless expansion coefficients for the two shear elastic constants.
output_schema: Object with top-level keys 'sc', 'fcc', 'bcc'. Each value is an object with numeric fields: A_M, A2, A3_I, A3_II, A3_III, B_M, B2, B3_I, B3_II, B3_III.

title: Determine fcc–sc and pt–fcc Gibbs free energy crossing pressures
action: For sc, fcc, and the primitive tetragonal (pt) structures, compute the total ground-state energy E(r_s) = E_eg(r_s) + E_st(r_s) using the structure-dependent components from the first step and the electron-gas energy formula. Convert each to Gibbs free energy G(P) via the pressure relation. Find the pressure P_c at which the free energies of fcc and sc cross, and the pressure at which the free energies of pt and fcc cross.
description: A JSON object containing the two crossing pressures in atomic units.
output_schema: Object with numeric fields: P_c_a_u (float, fcc–sc crossing pressure in a.u.), P_c_pt_fcc_a_u (float, pt–fcc crossing pressure in a.u.).

title: Compute primitive tetragonal upper-bound ground-state energy
action: For the primitive tetragonal lattice derived from sc by a volume-conserving tetragonal distortion parametrized by e3, compute the ground-state energy as a function of e3 at zero pressure. Minimize with respect to e3 to obtain the upper-bound ground-state energy per atom.
description: A JSON object containing the minimized ground-state energy in Rydberg.
output_schema: Object with a single numeric field: E_pt_Ry (float, upper-bound energy in Ry per atom).
